title: Ava has more clues

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: That was sad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That was sad.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: By searching the term "code-cleanse" I found an obscure order of the Church of Bicameral Mentality called “the Forsworn”.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: By searching the term "code-cleanse" I found an obscure order of the Church of Bicameral Mentality called “the Forsworn”.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Indeed. The Forsworn splintered from the main faith and held an anti-tech position.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. The Forsworn splintered from the main faith and held an anti-tech position.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It means of two halves. Those who follow the Bicameral Mentality believe in keeping half of their brain empty so they can hear the voice of the true gods.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It means of two halves. Those who follow the Bicameral Mentality believe in keeping half of their brain empty so they can hear the voice of the true gods.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: They splintered from the main faith and held an anti-tech position.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They splintered from the main faith and held an anti-tech position.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Quite. The Sect was disbanded by the Bicameral Council after just a few years of operation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Quite. The Sect was disbanded by the Bicameral Council after just a few years of operation.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: YT & TC. I’ll perform a search on any matching death records from the era. But it will take some time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: YT & TC. I’ll perform a search on any matching death records from the era. But it will take some time.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It’s possible. The Bicameral archives are off limits to civilians, but there’s a monk in Mountain Town who may be able to share knowledge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It’s possible. The Bicameral archives are off limits to civilians, but there’s a monk in Mountain Town who may be able to share knowledge.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It’s possible. The Bicameral archives are off limits to civilians, but Brother Jaynes may be able to share knowledge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It’s possible. The Bicameral archives are off limits to civilians, but Brother Jaynes may be able to share knowledge.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: They were claiming that the voice of God could not be heard through digital interference.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They were claiming that the voice of God could not be heard through digital interference.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: They set out to “cleanse” their followers' brains through aggressive surgeries. Many didn’t survive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They set out to “cleanse” their followers' brains through aggressive surgeries. Many didn’t survive.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You still there?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You still there?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What was she running from?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What was she running from?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bicameral what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bicameral what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bicameral, like that monk, Samual?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bicameral, like that monk, Samual?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ... OK. And the Forsworn?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... OK. And the Forsworn?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's horrible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's horrible.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She mentioned initials...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She mentioned initials...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What was she so scared of?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What was she so scared of?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What was she so scared of?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What was she so scared of?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So she was trying to run away from the Forsworn?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So she was trying to run away from the Forsworn?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So she was trying to run away from the Forsworn?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So she was trying to run away from the Forsworn?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ok.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How does that play into our ghost story?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How does that play into our ghost story?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How does that play into our ghost story?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How does that play into our ghost story?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She was sacrificed on the altar of madness.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She was sacrificed on the altar of madness.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She was sacrificed on the altar of madness.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She was sacrificed on the altar of madness.
